name: Tableau
author: qempexe
description: Eighteen window layouts in Omarchy's layout cycle: live miniatures around the window you use in Portrait, Landscape, Centerpiece and four Galleries, Diptychs, Triptych, Bento, Mosaic, Strip, Column, Spiral and Spread. A bar button and panel to pick layouts per workspace, set the window outline and choose what Super + L goes through.

barWidget.description: The focused workspace's layout, and the panel to pick layouts and set the outline
